scope: Public non-executable CSR identities only; no PIE instruction words retained or used

findings.fact: DFIINITCOMPLETESHADOW is a read-only view of sequencer-controlled DfiInitComplete; the older integration does not provide a target mapping.
Older layout identifies MASTER DFIINITCOMPLETE offset0xf9, adjacent DFIFREQRATIO0xfa. T736 observed frequency ratio is logical0x20000, so the old block offsets are not transplanted.
Modern host comments describe PMU execution followed by PHY DfiInitComplete and controller DFI handshake. This supplies no source-only replacement program or target direct-register control.
Another integration exposes old logical0x200f9 DFIINITCOMPLETE and0x200c9 PLLLOCKSTATUS. Its SCOM bus/layout are not T736 proof.

conclusion: The queried public interfaces do not establish a T736 direct DFI-complete register or independently authored PIE instruction encoding. No guessed completion write or old-generation offset access is proposed. This is a bounded search result, not a claim no public specification exists.
